name: player
title: Player
description: Controls of the page's own over a native audio or video element.
use: An episode, a talk, a product film: a recording a reader plays, seeks and listens to at their own speed, with controls drawn in the page's material. The media stays a native audio or video element with its controls attribute, which the browser's own controls answer until the behavior attaches and takes it away.

instead.when: A short voice message in a conversation, drawn as the shape of its sound
A picture or a video that plays by itself, with a caption
What the recording says, to read and to seek from

keyboard.action: Play or pause. Space on a button presses that button instead

Seek back or forward 5 seconds; on the seek track ArrowDown and ArrowUp do the same. The two change places in a right-to-left player. On the volume slider, the arrows set the volume as the native input does
Turn the volume up or down a tenth, away from the seek track and the volume slider
Turn the captions on or off, when the video has a captions or subtitles track
Enter or leave full screen, for a video where the browser allows it
Go to the start or the end. On the volume slider they set the least and the most volume

platform.feature: The controls attribute of the media element
platform.fallback: Without the behavior the media keeps it, and the browser's own controls play the recording; the player's row is hidden
The behavior hides a button the browser cannot use. On an iPhone, full screen is the system's own player
The volume slider, the time so far and picture in picture stay in the row at every width of the player

platform.feature: Style queries on a custom property (@container style())
platform.fallback: Over a still video the controls still fade; the pointer stays visible over the picture

classes.name: player
classes.description: The player of an audio recording: a raised sheet holding the row of controls, 6px in. Give it role="group" and an aria-label that names the recording

classes.name: player-video
classes.description: The player of a video: the frame itself, a dark field with a surface's corner, with the controls over its lower edge in the dark scheme. They fade while the video plays and the pointer is still

classes.name: player-media
classes.description: The native audio or video element, with its controls attribute: the fallback the behavior removes as it attaches

classes.name: player-controls
classes.description: The row of buttons, times and the seek track. Hidden while the media has its controls attribute

classes.name: player-button
classes.description: A quiet 32px control with one icon, 44px on touch screens. A toggle has aria-pressed and a fixed name: with player-off and player-on faces it shows the one for its state; with one face it sinks into a well while it is on

classes.name: player-play
classes.description: Play and pause, its icon a size up: pressed while the media plays. Name it Play

classes.name: player-mute
classes.description: Sound and silence: pressed while the media is muted. Name it Mute

classes.name: player-speed
classes.description: The speed, in figures, that opens a menu of speeds through popovertarget: a menu of label items, each around a radio menu-input whose value is a playback rate

classes.name: player-captions
classes.description: Captions on or off: pressed while the first captions or subtitles track is showing. Hidden when the video has none

classes.name: player-pip
classes.description: Picture in picture: pressed while the video plays in its own window. Hidden where the browser has none, and in a player narrower than 24rem

classes.name: player-fullscreen
classes.description: Full screen: pressed while the player fills the screen. Hidden where the browser does not allow it

classes.name: player-off
classes.description: The face of a toggle while it is off: the icon for play, sound, into full screen

classes.name: player-on
classes.description: The face of a toggle while it is on: the icon for pause, silence, out of full screen

classes.name: player-elapsed
classes.description: How much has played, in small tabular figures, left out of a player narrower than 24rem. The behavior writes it

classes.name: player-duration
classes.description: How long the recording is, in small tabular figures. The behavior writes it once the media knows

classes.name: player-seek
classes.description: The seek track: a slider as long as the row allows, with what has loaded drawn under what has played. The behavior sets its max, its value and an aria-valuetext in words

classes.name: player-volume
classes.description: The volume: a short slider from 0 to 1 beside the mute button, left out where the player is narrower than 26rem and hidden where the device does not let a page set it

states.name: native controls
states.description: The browser's controls are shown and the player's row is hidden: the behavior has not attached

states.name: pressed
states.description: A toggle that is on: it shows its player-on face, or sinks into a well when it has one face

states.name: disabled
states.description: Disabled ink and no answer to the pointer

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: The focus ring. Over a video, the controls do not fade while anything in the player has it

states.name: hidden
states.description: A control the browser cannot use, hidden by the behavior

properties.name: --player-buffered
properties.description: How much of the recording has loaded, from 0 to 1, drawn on the seek track. The behavior sets it

properties.name: --player-idle
properties.description: 1 while a playing video has had no pointer movement for a while, and the controls fade out; 0 otherwise. The behavior sets it

properties.name: --player-ratio
properties.description: The video's aspect ratio, held before it loads; without it the frame takes the video's own shape

properties.name: --player-inset
properties.description: Space between the sheet of an audio player and its controls

properties.name: --player-radius
properties.description: The player's corner: a control's corner plus the inset, and a surface's corner for a video

example: 0:00 0:00
